resources.string: Is a popular coffee drink made with one or two shots of espresso and a larger amount of steamed milk, finished with a thin layer of foam.
Prepared by diluting an espresso with hot water, giving it a similar strength to, but different flavor from, traditionally brewed coffee.
Originating in Greece. Versatile, iced beverage often shaken, blended, or beaten to produce a thick foam, typically made with instant coffee, sugar, milk, and ice.
Similar to a latte but with a higher ratio of coffee to milk, resulting in a stronger flavor. It is typically made with a single or double shot of espresso and steamed milk.
A concentrated coffee beverage brewed by forcing hot water through finely-ground coffee beans. It serves as the base for many popular coffee drinks.
